prompt:
You describe a block diagram or schematic from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What the diagram shows overall, in one sentence.
2. Every block or component, by its label.
3. Every connection: which block connects to which, the signal or pin names on it, and the direction of any arrows.
4. Every voltage, frequency, part value or other number shown, with its unit.

Figure type: block diagram or schematic
Section: 18. FLRC Modem (LR2021) > 18.2 FLRC Packet Handler > 18.2.1 Fixed-Length Packet Format
Caption: Figure 18-1: FLRC Fixed-length Packet Format
Text inside the figure (exact, from the PDF text layer): Preamble Sync Word | 0, 16 or 32 bits | Payload | 0 to 511 bytes | Payload | CRC | 0,2,3 or 4 | bytes | CRC checksum | Convolutional encoding | AGC Preamble | 1 to 4 bytes | Tail | 6 bits if | FEC used
Text that mentions the figure: The sizes of the Syncword, payload length, and CRC length can be configured using the command SetFlrcPacketParams. The CRC calculation is performed on the entire preceding packet, excluding the preamble.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Block diagram of FLRC Fixed-length Packet Format.

Blocks:
AGC Preamble
Preamble
Sync Word
Payload
Payload CRC
Tail

Connections:
AGC Preamble connects to Preamble.
Preamble connects to Sync Word.
Sync Word connects to Payload.
Payload connects to Payload CRC.
Payload CRC connects to Tail.
A line labeled "CRC checksum" connects from Payload CRC to the block preceding it (Payload).
A line labeled "Convolutional encoding" connects from Payload to the block preceding it (Payload).

Numbers and values:
AGC Preamble: 1 to 4 bytes
Sync Word: 0, 16 or 32 bits
Payload: 0 to 511 bytes
Payload CRC: 0,2,3 or 4 bytes
Tail: 6 bits if FEC used
